Accounting interview question

The #1 question in every banking interview.

Walk it through 3 statements. 30 seconds.

25% tax rate

Depreciation goes up $10. What happens to cash?

ADown $10
BDown $7.50
CNo change
DUp $2.50

Pick one, then swipe.

Answer
+$2.50
−$7.50
Net income$10 less profit, minus 25% tax
+$10
Add it backDepreciation isn't cash
+$2.50
CashYou saved $2.50 in taxes

D. −7.50 + 10 = +2.50

Balance sheet check

Both sides drop $7.50.

1Cash +$2.50, PP&E −$10 → assets −$7.50
2Retained earnings −$7.50 → equity −$7.50
✓It balances

Most common miss

Picking A: "cash goes down $10."

Depreciation is an expense on paper. No cash leaves. The only cash effect is the lower tax bill.
